note: Draft command rows: actions the chrome offers that the command table does not hold yet. The first five are the design-system record's (revision 6, Q5); the last four are Look Lab's own, for actions its Library and History offer (A6 re-check N-7), proposed to the record. They join the command table at its freeze; until then Look Lab registers them after the table's rows. Their default keys are drafted with the default keymap, so none is bound here; the palette can bind each one.

commands.label: Replay kept branch as preview
commands.note: Prepares the moves of a kept branch as one preview with its own checks and effects. It never commits; the solver commits the preview like any other (ADR-D01.16). Argument: the branch number.

commands.label: Preview: before beside after
commands.note: The preview view's stage compares the committed state with the state after the whole sequence, side by side (ADR-D01.10).

commands.label: Preview: before only
commands.note: The preview view's stage shows the committed state (ADR-D01.10).

commands.label: Preview: after only
commands.note: The preview view's stage shows the state after the whole sequence (ADR-D01.10).

commands.label: Preview: next side
commands.note: Cycles the preview view's stage through both, before and after (ADR-D01.10).

commands.label: Library: fold or open a branch
commands.note: Folds or opens one branch of the Library tree (ADR-D01.69). Argument: the branch title (Macros, Templates, Sets, Blocks, Saved states, Built-in). Proposed by Look Lab.

commands.label: Roll the layout history to a step
commands.note: Restores the arrangement of one step of the layout history as one layout action (ADR-D01.14). Argument: the step number. Proposed by Look Lab.

commands.label: History: show moves or layout
commands.note: Shows the move history or the layout history in the History dock (ADR-D01.14). Argument: moves or layout; none shows the moves. Proposed by Look Lab.

commands.label: History: open or close an entry
commands.note: Opens a move history entry in place to its moves, or closes it (ADR-D01.15). Argument: the entry id. Proposed by Look Lab.
